scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older bearded man in a cream tunic and rust-colored mantle sits on a wooden bench in a stone room. An iron cuff chains his wrist to a wall ring. He looks toward a sunlit barred window, his other palm open. A rolled parchment rests beside him, and a clay jug stands nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The chained figure represents Paul, whom the verse calls the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of the Gentiles. The room, clothing, parchment and reflective pose are imaginative details, not a documented scene from this verse. His calm expression suggests steadfast service; the window light is ordinary daylight. Christ and the Gentile readers are not pictured.
